subject: Shiny Installation Bug "bitops, caTools" will not be installed.

messages.author: dfd393aed4d6bc76
messages.subject: Shiny Installation Bug "bitops, caTools" will not be installed.
parts:
Hey Guys.

i cant install the shiny package. 
I did it over install.package("shiny") and everything worked out fine. It tryed out all examples which i had no problem with.

Then i tried to create my own shiny app. 

When running it R asks me to install shiny as an pop up.
When R tries to instill shiny i'll get the following message and that is not complete:
Pakete, die nur als Quelltext vorliegen und eventuell Übersetzung von 
  C/C++/Fortran benötigen.: 'bitops' 'caTools'
  These will not be installed.

after that i can close the pop up and the app will not run.

Translated this means:

"packages that are only avaliable as source code maybe need a translation from C/C++/Fortran: ...."



Does anybody know how to solve this?


(sorry for using this google account. But its the only one i have)

my best regards

Chris
